253004|fb513610.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

256742|424df33e.name: Dianne Softstep
256742|424df33e.text:
Ah, I am afraid you and I have no business at this time.

If you end up fulfilling some contracts with the trade authority then perhaps we will have something to discuss later.

3136|2e231d45.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|2e231d45.text: Yeah, I've heard through the grapevine that I might be seeing you sooner or later. But I don't just take on anyone, I need to make sure you have what it takes first. You willing to take my little test and find out?

5482|52392408.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the $r lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

91746-accept.name: Unknown
91746-accept.text: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746-accept.title: Elmpaw's Head

91746-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
91746-complete.text:
So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, $N!

Let me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.
91746-complete.title: Elmpaw's Head

92679-accept.name: Alvarion Windfield
92679-accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The $R man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679-accept.title: Blood Tithe

92699-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92699-accept.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92699-accept.title: The Supreme Magister

92699-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92699-complete.text:
Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.

With you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid The High Order?

I suppose we will see.
92699-complete.title: The Supreme Magister

92701-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92701-complete.text:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.
92701-complete.title: To Valanaar

92701-progress.name: Valennia Stormfist
92701-progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92701-progress.title: To Valanaar

92709-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92709-accept.text: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and its youth like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709-accept.title: A Grand Adventure

92709-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92709-complete.text:
So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.

Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.

While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.
92709-complete.title: A Grand Adventure

92727-accept.name: Dondallion Whisperwind
92727-accept.text:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92727-complete.name: Dondallion Whisperwind
92727-complete.text: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain you also notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>
92727-complete.title: The Missing Scholar

92741-accept.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-accept.text:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
92741-accept.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92849-accept.name: Unknown
92849-accept.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
92849-accept.title: The Missing Scholar
